batch.title: Constrained commercial and provider administration
batch.goal: Enforce finance read-only, contracts tracking-only, vendor delivery, and platform-internal provider administration.
exitCriteria: Organization Admin finance writes, contract signing/executed claims, and provider tools are hidden and server-denied.
Allowed read, tracking, notification, export, isolation, and internal-platform journeys pass.

findings.title: Finances ledger-only: no double-entry, USD hardcoded, payouts retry = status flip (no Stripe movement)
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Contracts: typed-name e-signature; contract.sign capability enforced nowhere; obligations GET-only; admin UI read-only
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Production still exposes obsolete internal utility/setup routes
findings.solution: Disable/remove in production; keep internal tooling behind explicit development/internal controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Finance, contract, and vendor tracking notifications are incomplete
findings.solution: Define scoped notification triggers, durable delivery records, recipient preferences, retry visibility, and explicit disabled states for deferred mutations/signatures.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved tracking and export events notify intended recipients once; deferred finance mutations and signatures remain inaccessible.
verificationRequirements: Producer, recipient, retry, cross-organization, and disabled-scope tests.

specTasks.title: Financial accounting boundary
acceptanceCriteria: Operational subledger scope, approval thresholds, settlement rules, and external accounting integration boundary

specTasks.title: Approve operational accounting ADR
acceptanceCriteria: Defines authoritative records, statuses/posting, currency/FX/rounding, approval/separation, settlement, correction, retention, and external system boundary.

specTasks.title: Inventory deployed finance data/policies
acceptanceCriteria: Table/policy/grant/row counts, org/parent coverage, currency formats, duplicates, orphan/raw IDs, and legacy consumers are documented.

blockers.reason: Repository inventory and read-only evidence pack complete; hosted Tourify Demo migration/policy/grant/row/quarantine/advisor output is required and cannot be inferred or executed without production access

specTasks.title: Approve contract lifecycle/provider ADR
acceptanceCriteria: Contract types/states, template/version, approval, signature modes, executed definition, amendment, obligation, retention and provider boundary are decided.

specTasks.title: Add/backfill validated organization scope
acceptanceCriteria: Every finance/budget/settlement child has resolvable org and parent consistency; unresolved rows are quarantined and inaccessible.

specTasks.title: Replace blanket RLS
acceptanceCriteria: Select/insert/update/delete require organization and finance capability; protected payment/person fields use narrower projection; direct-client tests pass.

specTasks.title: Harden finance commands
acceptanceCriteria: Allowed-field schemas, org/parent predicates, state transitions, idempotency, money validation, expected version, reason, and immutable audit are required.

specTasks.title: Remove raw UUID entry UX
acceptanceCriteria: Users select authorized tour/event/vendor/PO/category from scoped search; server still validates relation and state.

specTasks.title: Establish financial audit/reversal rules
acceptanceCriteria: Approved/posted/settled records cannot be deleted/overwritten; reversal/adjustment links and before/after evidence are tested.

specTasks.title: Migrate vendor/team/job routes to canonical tour access
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized organization/tour collaborators get consistent results; all mutations verify vendor/engagement/tour/event org and capability.

specTasks.title: Define vendor identity/deduplication
acceptanceCriteria: Legal/display name, locations, contacts, category, external accounting ID, duplicate detection, merge and retained alias/history rules are approved.

specTasks.title: Add protected vendor-data policy
acceptanceCriteria: Tax/payment/compliance documents and personal contacts have explicit fields/capabilities/retention; operational users receive least data.

specTasks.title: Create category/department hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Organization-owned codes/names, parent, reporting order, allowed scopes, active state, and mapping from legacy categories are complete.

specTasks.title: Build budget templates/versions
acceptanceCriteria: Apply template with preview; baseline/forecast/scenario/approved status and version history; approved version is immutable.

specTasks.title: Build budget-line editor
acceptanceCriteria: Quantity/rate/fixed/formula, original/reporting currency, owner, scope, vendor/contract/assumption and notes validate and roll up correctly.

specTasks.title: Add commitment/actual rollups
acceptanceCriteria: Purchase requests/POs/contracts/invoices/expenses/payroll estimate/travel/tickets/settlement post through typed source adapters and reconcile to budget.

specTasks.title: Add approval policy engine
acceptanceCriteria: Thresholds by amount/category/department/action, required approvers, separation, delegation/expiry, escalation, and audit are configurable.

specTasks.title: Build purchase request/PO/change order
acceptanceCriteria: Status lifecycle, lines, approvals, vendor/contract/budget, delivery scope, commitments, documents, change impact, and close/cancel are implemented.

specTasks.title: Build invoice match/status
acceptanceCriteria: Match invoice to PO/receipt/service, detect quantity/price/tax/currency variance, route exception/approval, and track exported/payment state without pretending to execute payment if not integrated.

specTasks.title: Build expense/receipt workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile upload is scanned, fields/currency/date/vendor/category/scope/splits validate, duplicates flag, submit/review/approve/reject/reimburse-export states are audited.

specTasks.title: Build cash-advance workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Request/approve/issue/acknowledge/spend/return/reconcile with custodian, currency, receipts, outstanding balance, due date, and escalation.

specTasks.title: Build per-diem policy/entitlement
acceptanceCriteria: Policy applies eligible days/locations/roles/meals/currency/rates/deductions; preview, approval, issue/export, and adjustments are traceable.

specTasks.title: Add multi-currency/FX service
acceptanceCriteria: Approved rate source/manual override policy, immutable applied rate, rounding, unavailable-rate handling, and original/reporting displays are tested.

specTasks.title: Define deal templates/formulas
acceptanceCriteria: Guarantee, percentage, versus, bonuses, tax/fees/deductions, promoter expenses, caps, and splits are versioned and reviewed by domain experts.

specTasks.title: Build settlement statement workspace
acceptanceCriteria: Imports ticket data, pulls approved costs/contracts, shows formula/evidence, supports adjustments/comments/version and prevents stale source use.

specTasks.title: Add settlement approval/signoff
acceptanceCriteria: Internal approval and external acknowledgement/signature/document are scoped/audited; approved statement posts actuals and variance idempotently.

specTasks.title: Add tour closeout/profitability
acceptanceCriteria: Completed stops roll gross/net revenue, commitments, actuals, outstanding items, settlement status and forecast/final margin with consistent definitions.

specTasks.title: Build vendor master
acceptanceCriteria: Scoped search/create/edit/category/contact/status/risk/compliance and merge workflow work without raw IDs; audit and field access apply.

specTasks.title: Build compliance document workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Requirement by category/jurisdiction, secure upload/scan, verification, issue/expiry, reminder/escalation, waiver reason/approver, and access log are complete.

specTasks.title: Build requirement/engagement workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Tour/event/stop/domain scope, deliverables, dates, quantities, budget, owner, sourcing method, status and downstream links are required as configured.

specTasks.title: Build RFP/invitation flow
acceptanceCriteria: Versioned requirement package, selected vendors, question period, due date/time zone, secure vendor response and delivery audit are implemented.

specTasks.title: Build quote submission/versioning
acceptanceCriteria: Structured lines/currency/tax/fees/assumptions/exclusions/validity/files; vendor revisions retain history and cannot see competitors.

specTasks.title: Build quote comparison/decision
acceptanceCriteria: Normalize totals/currency and non-price criteria; reviewer scores/comments/conflicts, approval, decision reason, and notification are audited.

specTasks.title: Create vendor performance closeout
acceptanceCriteria: Timeliness, quality, variance, incidents, compliance, reviewer/evidence, response, and approved aggregate feed future sourcing without exposing sensitive notes.

specTasks.title: Build versioned template library
acceptanceCriteria: Template/clauses, types, variables, owner, approval, effective state and immutable versions are permissioned and tested.

specTasks.title: Build contract draft workspace
acceptanceCriteria: Engagement/parties/template/structured terms/value/dates/files are validated; generated document references exact template/input/version/checksum.

specTasks.title: Add internal review/approval
acceptanceCriteria: Required reviewers by type/value/risk, comments/change requests, legal/finance/business approvals, delegation and separation are audited.

specTasks.title: Add counterparty negotiation versions
acceptanceCriteria: Upload/send/receive revisions, compare text/structured fields, comment/decision, and selected final version without overwriting history.

specTasks.title: Build signature adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Manual-upload and provider modes verify signatories/sequence, provider signatures/webhooks/replay, executed file/checksum, timestamps, failure/retry, and access.

specTasks.title: Add amendment/termination/renewal
acceptanceCriteria: New version/linked agreement preserves executed original; authority, reason, notice date, obligations, and downstream budget/PO/publication impact are shown.

specTasks.title: Build obligation tracker
acceptanceCriteria: Extract/enter deliverable/payment/notice/insurance/option/renewal milestones with owner/due/status/evidence/reminder/escalation and event/tour visibility.

specTasks.title: Connect contract to PO/invoice/settlement
acceptanceCriteria: Contract value/terms/obligations link finance records; mismatch/stale version is visible; finance posting remains in finance service.

specTasks.title: Create reconciliation jobs/dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Compare source totals to finance entries by type/date/currency/event/provider; mismatches have owner/status/evidence and never silently adjust.

specTasks.title: Add accounting export adapter
acceptanceCriteria: Versioned export maps stable accounts/vendors/projects/taxes/currencies and records external reference/status; retry does not duplicate.

specTasks.title: Finance observability
acceptanceCriteria: Alert on unauthorized attempts, failed postings/exports, stale FX, approval backlog, unmatched invoices, overdue cash, unsettled completed shows, and reconciliation variance.

specTasks.title: Migrate/retire legacy finance paths
acceptanceCriteria: Row/total/currency reconciliation passes; old writes/policies/raw-ID UX are removed; retention and historical access are approved.

specTasks.title: Vendor/contract observability
acceptanceCriteria: Alerts cover expiring compliance/contracts, unanswered RFP, expired quotes, stalled approvals/signatures, overdue obligations, delivery/invoice variance, and provider failure.

specTasks.title: Document security review
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover cross-org file IDs, signed URL expiry, malware/type spoof, token/provider webhook, redaction/projection, deleted member, and retention/legal hold.

specTasks.title: Migration and contract-shell cutover
acceptanceCriteria: Existing vendor/contract-like records map or remain explicitly legacy; Admin contracts route uses canonical workspace; no placeholder or orphan write remains.

workflows.title: Finance Read-Only Reporting and Export

producer.outcome: Reads scoped budgets, ledger records, and exports.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Organization users receive SELECT only when membership and finance capability match; all mutation paths are hidden and server-denied.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Finance viewers obtain correct scoped reports and cannot mutate or simulate money movement.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Authorized users see tracking state while signing and unverified execution remain unavailable.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers

Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.
